components.css: .ds-window { overflow: hidden; width: min(760px, 92vw); border: 1px solid #cacace; border-radius: var(--ref-radius-shell, 1.125rem); background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); color: var(--ref-text, #111); box-shadow: var(--ref-shadow, 1.75rem 2.25rem 4.5rem rgb(55 50 45 / 0.17)); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-titlebar { position: relative; display: flex; height: 4.6rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ref-line, #d4d4d7); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.98); } .ds-titlebar h2 { margin: 0; color: #5f5f67; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: 0.055em; } .ds-controls { position: absolute; left: 1.6rem; display: flex; gap: 0.72rem; } .ds-control { width: 1.18rem; height: 1.18rem; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-close { background: #eb665b; } .ds-minimize { background: var(--ref-yellow, #f2bd45); } .ds-status { background: var(--ref-green, #67c759); } .ds-window-layout { display: grid; min-height: 250px; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, 28%) 1fr; } .ds-sidebar { padding: 2rem 1.3rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--ref-line, #d4d4d7); background: var(--ref-sidebar, #f3f3f3); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 820; } .ds-sidebar::first-letter { color: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); } .ds-window-body { padding: 2rem; background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); }

components.name: Desktop Launch Shortcut
components.description: A large, labeled launch tile for the fixed desktop rail.
components.css: .ds-launch { display: flex; width: 6.2rem; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ref-text, #111); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-launch-glyph { display: grid; width: 5.8rem; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0.7rem 1rem 2rem rgb(48 45 42 / 0.12); transition: transform 220ms var(--ref-ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), box-shadow 220ms var(--ref-ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)); } .ds-launch-label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-launch:hover .ds-launch-glyph { transform: translateY(-0.25rem); box-shadow: 0.9rem 1.35rem 2.4rem rgb(48 45 42 / 0.16); } .ds-launch:active .ds-launch-glyph { transform: translateY(0.05rem) scale(0.98); } .ds-launch:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.18rem; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: The quiet persistent navigation row; the sample shows its active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; grid-template-columns: 1.8rem minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0.72rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.72rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ref-text, #111); font: 650 1rem/1.5 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.62); transform: translateX(0.15rem); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: translateX(0.15rem) scale(0.985); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.18rem; }

components.name: Floating Dock Control
components.description: A compact desktop dock launcher with a restrained open-state indicator.
components.css: .ds-dock-control { position: relative; display: grid; width: 3.1rem; height: 3.1rem; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ref-text, #111); cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-dock-control:hover, .ds-dock-control.ds-active { background: var(--ref-soft, #f7f7f7); } .ds-dock-control.ds-active::after { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -0.12rem; width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ref-text, #111); content: ''; } .ds-dock-control:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-dock-control:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.18rem; } .ds-dock-count { position: absolute; top: 0.1rem; right: 0; display: grid; width: 1.3rem; height: 1.3rem; place-items: center; border: 0.14rem solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); color: #fff; font: 800 0.72rem/1 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default bounded action used for modes, links, and compact tools.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 2.7rem; padding: 0.62rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--ref-line, #d4d4d7); border-radius: 0.65rem; background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); color: var(--ref-text, #111); font: 680 1rem/1.2 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms var(--ref-ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); color: var(--ref-accent-dark, #c8382c); transform: translateY(-0.1rem); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0.05rem) scale(0.985); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.18rem; }

components.name: Soft Fact Card
components.description: A flat tonal card for concise profile facts and supporting information.
components.css: .ds-fact-card { display: grid; min-height: 6.5rem; align-content: center; gap: 0.18rem; padding: 1.2rem 1.55rem; border: 1px solid #e0e0e2; border-radius: var(--ref-radius-card, 0.875rem); background: #fbfbfb; color: var(--ref-text, #111); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-fact-label { color: #626269; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-fact-card strong { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 790; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.12; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The shared readable field treatment for search, forms, and compact tools.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Search projects</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" type="search" placeholder="Try data analysis" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: var(--ref-text, #111); font: 760 0.82rem/1 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { min-height: 2.8rem; width: min(320px, 100%); padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--ref-line, #d4d4d7); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--ref-surface, #fff); color: var(--ref-text, #111); font: 500 1rem/1.5 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #73737a; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #b8b8bd; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(233 81 65 / 0.12); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.18rem; }

components.name: Mobile Dock Destination
components.description: One of five equal-width destinations in the app-native mobile dock.
components.css: .ds-mobile-destination { position: relative; display: grid; min-width: 0; height: 4.6rem; place-items: center; gap: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.15rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: #5d5d65; font: 700 0.66rem/1 'Figtree Variable', 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mobile-destination svg { color: var(--ref-text, #111); } .ds-mobile-destination:hover { background: var(--ref-soft, #f7f7f7); } .ds-mobile-destination.ds-active { color: var(--ref-text, #111); } .ds-mobile-destination.ds-active::after { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0.05rem; width: 1.25rem; height: 0.3rem; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ref-accent, #e95141); content: ''; } .ds-mobile-destination:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-mobile-destination:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--ref-accent, #e95141); outline-offset: 0.1rem; }

narrative.overview:
This portfolio is an Experience surface: the visitor enters a quiet, matte workspace and explores Jay's work through familiar operating-system behavior. The visual language keeps the application metaphor while rejecting glossy imitation, skeuomorphic chrome, and the generic long-scroll portfolio. The interface should feel direct, grounded, and editorial enough that the work remains the loudest element.

Warm gray surrounds matte-white application surfaces. A soft sidebar, black geometric type, thin neutral rules, restrained coral signals, and one family of down-right shadows create hierarchy without spectacle. The About app opens by default; persistent launchers let recruiters and collaborators move quickly without losing the sense of place.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, warm, and calm rather than glossy or nostalgic.
One shared desktop shell across every portfolio application.
Strong black Figtree hierarchy with Phosphor interface glyphs.
Coral appears as a precise active-state and action signal.
Portfolio content remains primary; operating-system chrome stays restrained.
Desktop discovery becomes a focused, app-native mobile flow.

rules.name: The Coral Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral identifies selection, focus, progress, or a primary directional moment; it never becomes a large decorative field or competes with portfolio media.

rules.name: The Weight-Before-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with Figtree size, weight, spacing, and tone before introducing boxes, color, or ornament.

rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule
rules.body: Every preserved portfolio app opens inside the same window, titlebar, navigation state, and dock architecture; do not turn individual apps into disconnected landing pages.

rules.name: The Portable Metaphor Rule
rules.body: Preserve OS-like navigation on small screens, but remove desktop-only furniture and drag behavior instead of shrinking the desktop composition.

rules.name: The One Grounded Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cast depth down and right from major floating structures only; cards inside a window remain flat.

rules.name: The Nested-Radius Rule
rules.body: Large radii belong to the outer shell and primary media; inner controls step down in radius so containers never look like stacks of unrelated bubbles.

rules.name: The Real Controls Rule
rules.body: OS-shaped elements are working controls with labels, keyboard behavior, state, and focus management; never use decorative window chrome that implies unavailable actions.

rules.name: The Return-to-Trigger Rule
rules.body: Opening an app moves focus into the relevant window or task; closing it returns focus to the connected launcher that opened it.

dos: Do keep the warm-gray canvas, matte-white surfaces, soft sidebar, black type, and coral signal roles stable across every app.
Do preserve the rail/window/sidebar/dock relationship on desktop and the focused full-screen window/bottom-dock relationship on mobile.
Do use semantic buttons, visible labels or accessible names, `aria-current` or `aria-pressed` for state, and polite live regions for dynamic feedback.
Do keep interactive targets at least the implemented 2.7-3.25rem heights and make hover, press, focus, and active states distinct.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`, keep Escape dismissal and Ctrl/Cmd+K AI search, disable drag on touch/mobile, and prevent horizontal content overflow.
Do retain all preserved OS applications and utilities while expressing them through the shared matte shell.
donts: Don't reintroduce glossy Vista-style gradients, glassmorphism, neon glow, wallpaper-led spectacle, or ornamental skeuomorphism.
Don't spread coral across large backgrounds or use it for arbitrary decoration; its rarity makes state changes legible.
Don't add shadows to nested cards, stack rounded cards inside rounded cards, or give each app a separate visual identity.
Don't shrink the desktop rail and sidebar onto mobile; use the purpose-built five-destination dock.
Don't hide focus outlines, depend on hover alone, remove accessible state attributes, or animate through a reduced-motion preference.
Don't replace the application architecture with a generic scrolling portfolio or remove working apps in the name of visual simplification.
